Airmax Remote Limited.main_product: Fleet management and vehicle telematics platform
Airmax Remote Limited.reason: Airmax Remote is an independent UK provider whose core operations and primary products center entirely around fleet vehicle telematics, GPS tracking, vehicle data (CAN bus diagnostics), and integrated video telematics (MaxCam).

Lanterne Ltd..reason: Lanterne does not provide its own vehicle telematics or GPS tracking platform. Instead, it is an automation layer that connects to existing telematics providers, booking platforms, and task systems to manage workflows and tasks. Therefore, it falls under compliance or operational software that integrates other vendors' telematics.
